n1.speaker: patel
n1.text: Thanks for coming in. Leslie couldn't make it, so you're here for Ryan's chat?

translations.fa: ممنون که اومدید. لزلی نتونست بیاد، پس شما برای گفت‌وگوی رایان اینجایید؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, Leslie asked me to come.
That's right. How is he doing?

n2.speaker: patel
n2.text: He's doing better. He's handed in all his homework this month. That's a first!

translations.fa: بهتر شده. این ماه همهٔ تکالیفش را تحویل داده. اولین باره!

branches.suggestion: Has he finished his science project?

n3.speaker: patel
n3.text: Not yet. He's started it, but he hasn't finished it. It's due on Friday.

translations.fa: هنوز نه. شروعش کرده، ولی تمومش نکرده. موعدش جمعه‌ست.

branches.suggestion: I'll help him at home this week.
branches.suggestionFa: این هفته تو خونه کمکش می‌کنم.

branches.suggestion: What has he done so far?

n4.speaker: patel
n4.text: He's chosen the topic — volcanoes — and he's made a model. It's very messy, but it works!

translations.fa: موضوع را انتخاب کرده — آتشفشان‌ها — و یه ماکت ساخته. خیلی شلخته‌ست، ولی کار می‌کنه!

branches.suggestion: A volcano model! Has it erupted yet?
branches.suggestionFa: ماکت آتشفشان! تا حالا فوران کرده؟

n5.speaker: patel
n5.text: Once — in the science lab. We've cleaned it up now! Has he talked to you about college?

translations.fa: یه بار — تو آزمایشگاه علوم. حالا تمیزش کردیم! با شما دربارهٔ کالج صحبت کرده؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, he's mentioned it. He wants to do engineering.
branches.suggestionFa: آره، اشاره کرده. می‌خواد مهندسی بخونه.

branches.suggestion: No, he hasn't said anything yet.

cultureNote.en: In England, many students go to a sixth-form college at 16 for A levels before university.
cultureNote.fa: در انگلستان بسیاری از دانش‌آموزان در ۱۶ سالگی برای A level به کالج می‌روند.

n6.speaker: patel
n6.text: Engineering suits him. Please tell Leslie he's improved a lot. I'm proud of him.

translations.fa: مهندسی بهش میاد. لطفاً به لزلی بگید خیلی پیشرفت کرده. بهش افتخار می‌کنم.

branches.suggestion: I will. She'll be really pleased.
Thank you for all your help.

n7.speaker: patel
n7.text: My pleasure. And tell Ryan — no more volcanoes in the lab!

translations.fa: خواهش می‌کنم. و به رایان بگید — دیگه آتشفشان تو آزمایشگاه ممنوع!
